# Krueger Architects

> A boutique architecture and interior design firm specializing in historic redevelopment and luxury commercial projects in Southern California.

Krueger Architects, led by principal Kurt Krueger, focuses on thoughtful architectural design and high-end interior collaborations. The firm is recognized for innovative redevelopment projects that honor historic architecture while serving contemporary commercial needs.
